scenario: [LTAC.2.2] with [LGRA.6.1]: an `after` duration is a `UNIT_LIT`, so a slot read naming a Duration does not parse. Rule `later` delays by `t.delay`, a `Duration` slot. Expected DS_PARSE_GENERIC. A compiler that parses the duration as an expression and lowers anything but a time-unit literal to a 0 ns timer compiles this. The refusal begins on line 9, the `after` line ([RCTS.1.2.34]). PATH: `dsc.parse.ltac_2_1_parse_after`, which takes one `unit_lit` token after `after`.
rules_ds:
schema Schedule scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    delay: Duration mutable

rule later:
    Schedule t
->
    log info "armed"
    after t.delay:
        log info "fired"
